newsitem.title: CANADA: Volvo Quebec unit in deal with workers.
newsitem.headline: Volvo Quebec unit in deal with workers.

text.p: Prevost Car Inc, a subsidiary of AB Volvo and Henlys Group Plc, said on Monday it reached a labor agreement with its 1200 employees after having suspended production for seven days at its three Quebec plants.
Plant workers voted 72.6 percent and office workers 94.6 percent in favor of the offer in a meeting on Sunday. Work resumed Sunday night.

"This negotiated settlement will contribute to the improvement of the workplace and permits the company to keep its competitive advantages," Prevost Car President and Chief Executive Officer Georges Bourelle said in a statement.
The deal provides for annual wage increases of three percent for the next three years.
Prevost Car, which makes various types of bus, is based in Ste. Claire near Quebec City.
It is 51 percent-owned by AB Volvo and 49 percent by Henlys Group.
